## 🚀 BONUS — Go Live
*deployment · GitHub Pages*

You finished the core quest 🎉. Now **deploy** something real: your agent card, on a public URL, built by a robot.

1. Your fork → **Settings** → **Pages** → *Build and deployment* → Source: **GitHub Actions**.
2. **Actions** tab → **🚀 Deploy Agent Card** → **Run workflow**.
3. Watch the two jobs: **build** (generates the HTML from your agent file) → **deploy** (publishes it).
4. Open `https://<your-username-in-lowercase>.github.io/{repo}/`

Then **`/check`**.

> This is the whole idea of CD: *code in Git → a pipeline → a live site*. Session 3 goes much deeper.
